subject: [PATCH v3 5/7] selftests/mm: check MADV_COLD and MADV_PAGEOUT on partly advised THPs

2026-10-19.patch_summary: This patch adds self-tests to check the behavior of MADV_COLD and MADV_PAGEOUT on transparent huge pages (THPs). Specifically, it tests that paging out a whole PMD-mapped THP swaps it without corrupting its contents, and that pages outside the range stay mapped after paging out a base page or half of a PMD- or PTE-mapped THP. Additionally, it checks that MADV_COLD on half of either THP preserves its contents. The tests skip when PMD-sized THPs cannot be allocated, and the MADV_PAGEOUT tests also skip if MADV_PAGEOUT cannot swap.
